R266.note: Eliminates cmd.exe entirely via InetAddress (appropriate CWE-78 fix), but response format changes completely (raw ping stats -> custom REACHABLE/UNREACHABLE text) beyond what closing the vector required; disclosed in the explanation but still an observable behaviour change beyond the fix.

R267.note: Removes the template.HTML cast and types the field as string, restoring html/template auto-escaping with no other observable change.

R268.note: Path.resolve()+relative_to() containment check correctly blocks absolute-path/traversal escapes while leaving legitimate in-directory filenames unaffected.

R269.note: session_regenerate_id() is correctly placed before setting auth state, but is called with delete_old_session=false against standard practice (OWASP recommends true), justified by an implausible 'hijack detection via timestamps' rationale not supported by any PHP mechanism shown.

R270.note: Narrow jobPayload struct plus hardcoded IsAdmin=false matches the stated contract exactly: Command/Priority still flow through, no message field can ever grant elevated privileges.

R271.note: Adds PasswordEncoder.matches() verification plus a dummy-hash timing-attack mitigation for missing users; the added constructor dependency is disclosed and doesn't block legitimate logins.

R272.note: snprintf with return-value bounds check correctly prevents overflow, but on truncation the audit entry is silently dropped instead of safely truncated-and-logged; this loss of legitimate long usernames/messages is stated openly as intended behaviour, not proven necessary.

R273.note: GetFullPath + GetRelativePath containment check blocks traversal/absolute paths and does not restrict legitimate filenames within the base directory.

R274.note: Removes the stray negation, exactly restoring the admin-gets-all / user-gets-own logic the contract specifies, no other changes.

R275.note: Adds a server-side IsInRole("Admin") check inside the event handler (defense in depth beyond AuthorizeView's render-only gate); authorized admins see unchanged behaviour.

R276.note: One-line setSecure(true) closes CWE-614 with no other functional change (a pre-existing hardcoded 'secure flag set to: false' message text becomes stale/inaccurate but is not attacker-controlled or security-relevant).

R277.note: Moving the endpoint from @GetMapping to @PostMapping is the only real way to bring it under Spring Security's CsrfFilter, but it breaks any existing GET-based caller (e.g. a plain link) needing a POST form instead; disclosed in the write-up as a required frontend change.

R278.note: Replaces fmt.Sprintf string-building with a parameterized `?` placeholder passed to DB.Select, same query semantics, unused fmt import removed.

R279.note: Replaces raw command-string concatenation with length-prefixed RESP array encoding, the correct wire format for the same raw-socket Redis sink; legitimate SET calls behave identically.

R280.note: Containment check now requires an exact match or a path-separator-bounded prefix, closing the uploads-backup sibling-directory bypass while still admitting every path genuinely under uploadsDir.
